evals.name: gold-signal-extraction
evals.prompt: Run the signal extractor skill to extract trading signals from Telegram channels. The skill should scan channels, extract BUY/SELL signals for GOLD with ENTRY, SL, and TP, deduplicate them, and output JSON.
evals.expected_output: Extracted signals in JSONL format with proper deduplication

assertions.name: state_file_created
assertions.description: State file created with channels and message tracking

assertions.name: jsonl_output_valid
assertions.description: JSONL output contains valid JSON objects with required signal fields

evals.name: resumable-execution
evals.prompt: Test that the skill resumes from where it left off. Run the extractor twice and verify it only processes new messages the second time.
evals.expected_output: Second execution processes only new messages, no re-processing of old ones

assertions.name: incremental_processing
assertions.description: Only new messages processed on second run
